heading.title: Execution, Suspension, Remission and Commutation of Sentences

article.title: Return of warrant on execution of sentence
article.content: When a sentence has been fully executed, the officer executing it shall return the warrant to the Court from which it is issued, with an endorsement under his hand certifying the manner in which the sentence has been executed.
article.html:
470Return of warrant on execution of sentence

Section 470 · Chapter XXXIV · General provisions regarding execution

When a sentence has been fully executed, the officer executing it shall return the warrant to the Court from which it is issued, with an endorsement under his hand certifying the manner in which the sentence has been executed.
